result.summary: The page renders mostly well, with a few minor visual/layout issues: a partially cut-off restaurant card in the horizontal carousel, truncated restaurant name text, and inconsistent card heights in the 'Fastest near you' row.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the right edge of the screen, which is expected for a carousel, but only a sliver of the image and text is visible with no strong visual cue that more content is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle peek of the next card (e.g., show ~30-50% of it) or a pagination indicator/dots to make the horizontal scroll affordance clearer.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol…' is truncated mid-word, and the truncated card has no visible delivery time label placement consistent with the others.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the name truncates with an ellipsis ('Trattoria Picco…') and keep the delivery time chip in a consistent position across all cards.

issues.description: Card heights in the 'Fastest near you' row are inconsistent — the middle card (Smash Bros Burgers) sits lower than the others because its title/delivery text align differently, making the row look misaligned.
issues.suggestion: Fix image heights and align text blocks so all cards in the carousel share the same top and bottom edges.

issues.description: The promotional banner (green) uses white text on a medium green background; the secondary line 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' may have low contrast for some users.
issues.suggestion: Verify contrast ratio meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) for the smaller banner text, darkening the green or bolding the text if needed.
